baseline_justifications: The property specifies resolving an entity that is part of the interaction 'even though it was never explicitly mentioned in the dialogue.' CREAD resolves anaphora/ellipsis by recovering entities that WERE introduced in prior turns; it does not target entities absent from the explicit dialogue text, so it does not match this specific definition.

Property requires resolving an entity that is part of the interaction yet 'never explicitly mentioned in the dialogue.' CREAD resolves anaphora/ellipsis whose antecedents ARE present in prior turns of the dialogue; it does not target entities that were never explicitly mentioned.
